thread:
Priya Gupta: quick heads-up — PR #14232 is hitting failing e2e during the merge window. Need a fast call: rerun CI or update snapshots? I don't want to block the release.
Ben Liao: which test is failing? logs?
Priya Gupta: failing test: `e2e/login_flow_slow.test.ts` — intermittent timeout in the login step. CI log snippet below:
```
FAIL e2e/login_flow_slow.test.ts
  ● Login flow › completes within 8s
    TimeoutError: waiting for selector \"#dashboard\" failed: timeout 8000ms
      at TimeoutError (node_modules/playwright-core/lib)
      at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```
Priya Gupta: changed files in the PR are mainly auth/ and a small CSS tweak for login button. No snapshot files touched intentionally.
Jordan Kim: ugh, login_flow_slow has flaked before when infra load spikes. Historically rerun once or twice and it passes ~80% of time. Link to flaky history: https://qa.internal/flakes/LOGIN_FLOW_SLOW
Maya Patel: if it's a transient infra flake we should rerun, but given it's the merge window we need a plan if rerun stays red. Can we gate the merge on a successful rerun within 2 attempts?
Ben Liao: +1 to a single rerun. If it fails twice, let's cancel the merge and do a hotfix branch for the release.
Priya Gupta: buildkite-bot reported a rerun queued: buildkite.com/r/redwood/14232/23
buildkite-bot: Build #23 started (rerun by Priya Gupta)
Ben Liao: while it runs can someone eyeball the PR for any flaky-inducing waits? I can take a quick pass.
Jordan Kim: I can run the failing test locally with `yarn test:e2e e2e/login_flow_slow.test.ts --retries=0` and watch timing. FYI we saw a 50ms race in auth hook a while back — unlikely but possible.
QA-dashboard: Note: this test has a 7.2% historical flake rate in the last 30 days; median runtime spikes during peak deploys.
Priya Gupta: rerun finished: buildkite-bot: Build #23 failed again — same timeout. Link: buildkite.com/r/redwood/14232/23
Ben Liao: okay that's 2/2. Looks systemic. I'm going to run it with debug flags.
Jordan Kim: share the local run output if you can. If it's a real regression we should pin the PR out of the merge window and open a hotfix as Maya suggested.
Ben Liao: local run shows login wait jumped to ~12s once, likely due to a slower auth response after the CSS tweak triggered a small extra layout reflow. Suspect `login-button` selector change introduced a repaint.
Priya Gupta: hmm the selector change was to add `data-testid=\"login-btn\"` and we updated the selector to `button.login-btn`. Tests still use `#login-submit` though. PR diff: auth/login.tsx (button markup) and styles/login.css
Maya Patel: given evidence, this looks like a regression. Let's revert the selector change in the PR and run CI again. We can do a quick patch that keeps the `data-testid` but doesn't remove `id`.
Priya Gupta: ok creating commit to restore `id=\"login-submit\"` and keep `data-testid` in place. Pushing now.
buildkite-bot: Build #24 started (rerun after push)
Ben Liao: I'll watch build #24. If green, approve and we merge.
Jordan Kim: if it still flakes after the revert we escalate to the infra team for the auth backend latency.
buildkite-bot: Build #24 passed ✅
Priya Gupta: great — tests passed. @Maya Patel can you review/approve when you get a sec? We want to close the merge window before EOD.
Maya Patel: reviewing now. quick comment inline about leaving both selectors for test stability. approving after that. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: approved.
Priya Gupta: thanks all — merging now. Note for postmortem: add the selector stability note to the flaky-tests doc and add a small test helper to prefer `data-testid` to reduce CSS-induced breakage.
Ben Liao: noted. I'll add a follow-up task in the infra board for monitoring auth latency during merge windows.
Priya Gupta: closing thread — thanks! :party_parrot:
